rules.normal_maneuver: any formation, Action+1C, Exhaustion blocks initiation
rules.opening_orders: two per player after post-Pass closing turns
rules.stratagem_cap: one set Stratagem card per player per Battle, even if free

stratagem_roles.the-ground-was-held: Final provisional-score tie/one-point comeback, never an Opening Order. Named requirement is a payoff condition, not a Maneuver requirement.
stratagem_roles.the-lines-held: One final Move and +2 at post-order Stratagem resolution; unlike an Opening Maneuver it happens after all revealed orders.
stratagem_roles.no-step-back: Prevents a hostile Tactic or Attack affliction, including a legal Opening Strike; does not duplicate a secret order.
stratagem_roles.the-center-must-hold: One leadership-gated same-rank exchange across two active Fronts after opening movement, not another opening Move/Commit.
stratagem_roles.the-flank-was-refused: Outer Front anti-flank restores its penalty and adds +2 to one flanked Frontline Force; no movement or Commit.
stratagem_roles.the-trap-closed: One attached-layer loss after Raider/Skirmisher affliction, including Opening Strike outcomes.
stratagem_roles.the-battle-turned-east: Triggered extra legal Rider Move/+1 when a Rider moves, including an Opening Maneuver; still costs the player's one pre-set Stratagem slot.
stratagem_roles.there-was-no-road-back: Named-completion trap is prepared during turns, not a second Opening Order.
stratagem_roles.every-banner-turned-toward-them: Broader delayed King/Captain +Strength in multiple Fronts, paid 2C and the only Stratagem slot.
stratagem_roles.the-archers-were-ready: Counterattack after an opposing Attack, including an Opening Strike; requires unused legal Archer Attack.
stratagem_roles.the-scouts-had-warned-them: Triggers on opponent setting their single Stratagem before Pass; late Opening Orders do not secretly set another one.
